verdict.rationale: A downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question for a SaaS code-hosting platform, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never documents one. The OpenAPI probe found every candidate path returning 404 on support.atlassian.com, though it only checked the support domain, not a developer-docs domain. The generic 'build custom integrations' claim and the MCP server belong to other stories and earn no credit here.
